title_zh: 选择有口述导览和座位的展览时段

scenario.label_zh: 确认展览口述导览及座椅
scenario.goal_zh: 核对口述导览和便携座椅的可用性，预留导览名额与座椅并确认集合时间

context_zh: 一位失明参观者向画廊接待员了解展览的无障碍导览和休息安排。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I'm blind. Does this exhibition have an audio description or a guided visit?

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: There's a live description tour at two. The guide describes the colourful paintings and the way the paint has been applied.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Can I sit down during the tour? Standing for a long time is difficult for me.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Certainly. We have portable chairs, and you can move one between the rooms.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: That would make a real difference to my comfort. Is there space on today's tour?

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Yes. Would you like me to reserve a place and a chair?

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Please do. My name is Rosa Lane.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: You're on the list, Rosa. Come back to this desk at ten to two.
